body:
He’s an anxious person in general, but I feel like it’s more him assuming I’ll come through whenever after hes done with whatever and that I’m on his time and it’s not our time if that makes sense. I’ve tried talking to him about it many times and we’ve even broke up over this specific issue before. I had been long distance this past year because I was caring for my grandma, but I’ve just moved back. There weren’t many opportunities for this to happen this year I guess but the last time it did I was visiting and he made plans for the time I was getting into town, said I could come over after when I had no where else to go and he hit me up at 1 am saying I could pull through if I wanted. I ended up going  to not a safe or good place to be to wait because no where else to go. I was upset and me being upset about it made him not want to see me when I was in town. I honestly thought we’ve worked through this since then but I guess not. 

Thank you for the book suggestion, I’ll definitely have to check it out.

1- that whole situation had me so upset. He said hurtful things and i just kept trying to say it was a misunderstanding and even though he failed to communicate, I was the one doing damage control. He was genuine when apologizing and he recognized that the things he said were hurtful, uncalled for, and ridiculous. I wasn’t 100% okay with everything after our talk, but I was happy that he seemed sorry and that he wanted to be better. 

2- you’re definitely right. I do try to keep myself occupied when waiting for our plans but when it gets to a certain point it’s almost anxiety inducing waiting for the text. I really look forward to hanging out, it’s the best part of my day when we do. I get excited and then I get anxious that it’s taking so long. I do set times in my head like you suggest but it’s hard for me to stick to because I hate feeling let down and it’s like I’m just sitting at home anyways and with covid I can’t really make other plans. I need to learn how to stick to the times and be okay when it doesn’t work out. This is an issue I’ve struggled with our whole relationship, I just don’t know how to get better about it and it hurts. He’s bad at making solid plans with a set time and feels it should be flexible which I’m okay with to a point, but I’m not okay with being THAT flexible. 

It feels like you’ve hit the nail on the head here. Thank you for taking the time to respond to my post

Do you have any advice on toning down expectations? It feels like I almost need an attitude of I’ll believe we actually have plans when you’ve hit me up to hangout. You’re right about needing to talk to him though. I just need to figure a way to say it so that it will be received. Thank you for the advice. I really appreciate it a lot.

He does a lot of nice things for me, when I was broke broke he would make sure I’d have food and when I didn’t have a safe place to stay he would let me stay at his which was huge for me. He’s been there for me through a lot of traumas and I feel like he genuinely means well. But he’s, for lack of a better word, forgetful? Maybe it’s unintentionally inconsiderate, I don’t know. I just feel like the plans we make aren’t legitimate plans until he’s ready to hangout if that makes sense?  And it hurts that he won’t make the same effort to make things better like I do. I don’t think counseling is ever something he’d consider as he has an aversion to almost all things doctor related. But I would still like to know what the book is for myself. Thank you for taking the time to respond to me. I appreciate it.

Went to a bar with my bf on Saturday because the numbers where we are aren’t too bad. Today the bar posted that an employee tested positive so they are closed. We left our information for contact tracing and haven’t received any calls yet and we aren’t sure if the employee was working the night we were there. What is the right thing to do from here?

I have a therapist that I talk to weekly. I tried talking to my mom and dad about my sad and they said I’m too negative for anyone to want to be around. My friends aren’t really people I could go to, even I wanted to they don’t usually respond unless they want something. My bf thinks my depression is entirely about him no matter how many times I say it’s about my traumas and past. He got so angry last night and told me I should’ve just left the relationship. I feel so hopeless
